cd /tmp/obench-cell-sstw1wym/bench_opencode_sam-cell-seg_jspxjsih; W=/opt/uvcache/git-v0/checkouts/e7d9320a8522f22d/f706ad9/weights/mobile_sam.pt; s=$(date +%s); python convert_masks.py $W /tmp/out_t demo_rgb.png demo_metadata.csv > /tmp/log.txt 2>&1; echo $(( $(date +%s)-s ))s; tail -1 /tmp/log.txt; cat > /tmp/validate.py <<'EOF'
import sys,numpy as np,pandas as pd,cv2
inp=pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1]); out=pd.read_csv(sys.argv[2]); img=cv2.imread(sys.argv[3])
h,w=img.shape[:2]
assert list(inp.columns)==list(out.columns) and len(inp)==len(out)
same=[c for c in inp.columns if c not in('xmin','xmax','ymin','ymax','coords_x','coords_y')]
assert inp[same].equals(out[same]), "other columns changed"
cnt=np.zeros((h,w),int); ious=[]
for (_,a),(_,b) in zip(inp.iterrows(),out.iterrows()):
    xs=list(map(int,b.coords_x.split(','))); ys=list(map(int,b.coords_y.split(',')))
    assert len(xs)==len(ys)
    pts={(x,y) for x,y in zip(xs,ys)}
    assert not (len(pts)<=4 and len({p[0] for p in pts})<=2 and len({p[1] for p in pts})<=2), "rectangle"
    assert (b.xmin,b.xmax,b.ymin,b.ymax)==(min(xs),max(xs),min(ys),max(ys))
    m=np.zeros((h,w),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m,[np.array([xs,ys]).T.astype(np.int32)],1)
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m,connectivity=4); assert n==2,"not contiguous"
    cnt+=m
    o=np.zeros((h,w),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(o,[np.array([list(map(int,a.coords_x.split(','))),list(map(int,a.coords_y.split(',')))]).T.astype(np.int32)],1)
    ious.append(((m&o).sum()/(m|o).sum(), a.type))
assert cnt.max()<=1, "overlap"
d=pd.DataFrame(ious,columns=['iou','type']); print("OK; IoU vs original:\n",d.groupby('type').iou.describe())
EOF
python /tmp/validate.py demo_metadata.csv /tmp/out_t/demo_metadata.csv demo_rgb.png
